Hojun · Listen & Shadow 11

Built Where It Shouldn't Be — four Hyundai E&C sites
D O   E N G L I S H   W I T H   B R I A N
PART 1 · JUBAIL
👤 Colleague
Jubail — what made it such a big deal?
주베일 산업항, 뭐가 그렇게 대단했어요?
big deal — 대단한 일
💬 Hojun
They landed 500-ton structures within tolerance in thirty meters of water.
수심 30미터에서 500톤짜리 구조물을 오차 안에 앉힌 거예요.
land — 앉히다, 설치하다 · tolerance — 허용 오차
같은 패턴으로 — They landed the caisson within a few centimeters. · We set the pile within tolerance on the first try.
💬 Hojun
And they fabricated everything in Korea and shipped it over.
자재는 전부 한국에서 만들어서 배로 실어 날랐고요.
fabricate — 제작하다 · ship over — 배로 보내다
같은 패턴으로 — We fabricated the jackets in Ulsan and shipped them out. · They built the modules at home and shipped them over.
💬 Hojun
The hard part is controlling that weight on the waves.
어려운 건 파도 위에서 그 무게를 제어하는 거예요.
control — 제어하다
같은 패턴으로 — The hard part is the weather window. · The hard part is keeping the crane steady.
💬 Hojun
That only works on a calm day.
바다가 잔잔한 날에만 되는 얘기죠.
calm — 잔잔한
같은 패턴으로 — That only works with a big enough crane. · That only works if the survey is right.
PART 2 · BOSPHORUS
👤 Colleague
Why did the third Bosphorus bridge go hybrid?
보스포러스 3대교는 왜 하이브리드로 갔어요?
hybrid — 두 방식을 섞은
💬 Hojun
A pure suspension bridge sways too much to carry a railway.
현수교만으로는 흔들려서 철도를 못 놓거든요.
suspension bridge — 현수교 · sway — 흔들리다
같은 패턴으로 — A pure cable-stayed design would be too short. · A pure steel deck would be too heavy.
💬 Hojun
So they mixed in cable-stayed to stiffen it.
그래서 사장교를 섞어서 강성을 높였어요.
cable-stayed — 사장교 방식 · stiffen — 단단하게 하다
같은 패턴으로 — So they mixed in steel to stiffen the deck. · They added a truss to stiffen it.
💬 Hojun
You'd have to have nerve to sign off on a world first.
세계 최초를 서명하려면 배짱이 필요하죠.
nerve — 배짱 · sign off on ~ — ~를 승인하다
같은 패턴으로 — You'd have to have nerve to try that design. · Signing off on that takes nerve.
PART 3 · CHACAO AND ULSAN
👤 Colleague
Chacao — what do you design for first?
차카오는 뭐부터 설계해요?
design for ~ — ~를 기준으로 설계하다
💬 Hojun
I'd design for the earthquake first, then the wind.
저라면 지진을 먼저 잡아요. 바람은 그다음이고요.
earthquake — 지진
같은 패턴으로 — I'd design for the current first. · I'd design for the worst month first.
💬 Hojun
The risk there is the current — it changes direction twice a day.
거기서 위험한 건 조류예요 — 하루에 두 번 방향이 바뀌니까요.
current — 조류 · direction — 방향
같은 패턴으로 — The risk there is the wind picking up. · The risk is the tide catching the barge.
💬 Hojun
First Korean bridge in South America — there's a lot to prove.
한국 건설사가 남미에 처음 짓는 다리니까 증명할 게 많죠.
prove — 증명하다
같은 패턴으로 — There's a lot to prove on a first job. · On a job like that, you have a lot to prove.
💬 Hojun
Ulsan Bridge crosses 1,150 meters with just two towers.
울산대교는 1150미터를 주탑 두 개로 건넜어요.
cross — 건너다 · tower — 주탑
같은 패턴으로 — It crosses the harbor with one span. · The bridge crosses the strait with three towers.
💬 Hojun
What impresses me is it was third in the world when it opened.
인상적인 건 준공 때 세계 3위였다는 거예요.
impress — 감명을 주다 · open — 개통하다
같은 패턴으로 — What impresses me is the schedule. · What impresses me is they did it without a single accident.
PART 4 · THE VERDICT
👤 Colleague
Of the four, which is the real feat?
넷 중에 진짜 대단한 건 뭐예요?
feat — 위업, 대단한 일
💬 Hojun
I'd say Jubail is the real one — they did it in 1976.
진짜는 주베일이라고 봐요. 1976년에 그걸 했으니까요.
I'd say ~ — 제 생각엔 ~
같은 패턴으로 — I'd say the Bosphorus is the real one. · I'd say Chacao will be, once it's done.
💬 Hojun
Jubail needed money, but the Bosphorus needed nerve.
주베일은 돈이, 보스포러스는 배짱이 필요했죠.
need — 필요하다
같은 패턴으로 — Ulsan needed precision, but Chacao needs patience. · One needed time; the other needed courage.
💬 Hojun
What hasn't changed in fifty years is that the sea is still the sea.
50년이 지나도 안 변한 건, 바다는 여전히 바다라는 거예요.
what hasn't changed is ~ — 안 변한 건 ~
같은 패턴으로 — What hasn't changed is the weather. · What hasn't changed is that steel is heavy.
녹음 19/19
